x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

min_num = 0
min_den = 1

for den in range(1, n + 1):
    approx = (x * den) / y
    num = int(approx)
    if approx - num > 0.5:
        num += 1
    if (y * den) * abs(x * min_den - min_num * y) > (y * min_den) * abs(x * den - num * y):
        min_num = num
        min_den = den

print(f"{min_num}/{min_den}")
